title: Concept: Overflow checks disabled by unchecked block (solidity) — review required
description: In solidity 0.8 and later, arithmetic reverts on overflow unless it sits in an unchecked block. Inside such a block, a value can wrap around and pass later comparisons. The remedy is checked arithmetic, with unchecked kept to proven-bounded loop counters.
applicability: solidity contracts compiled with Solidity 0.8 or later that use unchecked blocks; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Silent wraparound in balances, supply, or reward math, which can drain or mint value; MEDIUM severity pending the reviewer's bound analysis.
